description: The chart is a sunburst diagram representing the distribution of abusive and non-abusive content across various categories. The diagram consists of two main categories and multiple subcategories, totaling 18 slices. The two main categories are "Abusive" (teal) and "Not Abusive" (yellow), which occupy approximately 55% and 45% of the chart, respectively. The "Abusive" category is further divided into subcategories, including "Other" (Negative, ~25%), "Political" (Negative, ~20%), "Racial" (Negative, ~5%), and "Sexist" (Negative, ~3%), as well as a small "Mixed" subcategory. The "Not Abusive" category is also divided into subcategories, including "Other" (~15%), "Neutral" (~10%), "Political" (various sentiments, ~8%), "Religious" (Positive, ~5%), and several smaller subcategories labeled "Positive", "Mixed", "Neutral", and "Negative". The chart does not include a legend, but labels are provided for each slice. The subcategories are visually nested within their respective main categories, with the sizes of the slices varying to represent their relative proportions.
